name: smwmusic-touhou-hisouten-scarlet-weather-rhapsody-drunk-as-i-like-smw-mix
title: Touhou Hisouten ~ Scarlet Weather Rhapsody - Drunk As I Like (SMW-Mix)
description:
The song that plays in the cutscene before you fight Suika Ibuki, but most of you probably know it from the Demoman YTPMV (Also know as "Drunk As I Like") or the Silva-rip of "Mario Party - Play A Mini-game! (Drunk Mix)." Not exactly 1:1 with the original, but more of a remix, with some things being the same as before, but other things not so much.

It could fit small cutscenes, credits, title screens, or even some calm levels.

Also, it's my first port to ever upload onto here. Yay!

Note: In the txt file, there are four customizable options that allow you to change the pitch of the song to either the d minor (original), c# minor, c minor, and b minor. If you don't know what those mean, mess with the options and you'll get it.
